faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for NAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Therapist (Female): maximum 40 years; Therapist (Male): maximum 40 years; Pharmacist (Homoeopathy): maximum 40 years; Yoga Instructor (AHWC): maximum 50 years; Data Entry Operator: maximum 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 14,700 for Therapist (Female), 14,700 for Therapist (Male), 14,700 for Pharmacist (Homoeopathy), 14,000 for Yoga Instructor (AHWC), 14,175 for Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Varies by post: 7th class (Sanitation Worker), 10th class (Attender), Plus Two (Multipurpose Worker), ANM/GNM nursing certificate, diploma/certificate courses, any degree with DCA/PGDCA (Data Entry Operator), BNYS/BAMS/MSc Yoga/MPhil Yoga, Physiotherapy degree or PG degree. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Yoga Demonstrator: skill test qualification is mandatory for all listed qualifications. Computer knowledge (MS Office) is required for Multipurpose Worker, Multipurpose Health Worker (AHWC) and the Physiotherapy Unit, Osteoarthritis and Musculoskeletal and Karunya Multipurpose Worker posts. Kerala Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate is required for Multipurpose Health Worker (AHWC) and the Osteoarthritis and Musculoskeletal and Karunya Multipurpose Worker posts.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications are rejected without consideration. Applications are rejected when the details given do not match the original documents produced at the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Skill test / written test and interview, as required. Selection may include a skill test or written test and an interview, as required.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary appointment on contract basis. Vacancy column of each post is marked Anticipatory.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ernakulam district (National Ayush Mission, Ernakulam).
